responsibility: Core IDs, handles, structured results/errors, diagnostics, API version/capabilities, build identity, and backend-neutral time metadata values.

lifetime.creation: explicit consumer construction or value creation; no global runtime owner
lifetime.shutdown: RAII/value destruction with no dependency-owned shutdown sequence

threading.concurrency: OperationId generation is thread-safe; immutable/value contracts are caller-owned; mutable instance owners require their documented caller synchronization

invariants.text: Foundation remains independent from platform, renderer, UI, APaint, and third-party runtime dependencies.
Stale or forged typed handles never resolve as live values.
Structured errors preserve owner and operation identity across Result failure paths.
DiagnosticLog is instance-owned, bounded, and discards the oldest breadcrumb at capacity.
Monotonic time metadata is a trivially copyable fixed-width foundation value with no platform or backend dependency.
